context.purpose: Check the structure and source identities of an already open saved Premiere sequence through documented read-only UXP APIs. Experimental integration; native qualification is pending.
context.assumptions: Windows/macOS host, Premiere 26.5+, UDT 2.2+, supplied panel loaded in developer mode, exact native project/source paths and an idle active sequence. Local private bridge folder.
context.constraints: One unmuted contiguous video track, 1..128 clips, at most 600 timeline frames, integer 24/25/30/50/60 fps, zero sequence start, empty audio tracks, no captions/transitions/disabled/adjustment/reversed/offline/nested/merged/multicam/proxy clips. Effects and source/rendered bytes are not checked.
context.inspection: Compare exact native ticks, ordered source identities, project/sequence GUIDs, dimensions and runtime identity. Two complete matching observations detect observed concurrent edits without claiming atomicity.
context.recovery: NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE on Linux is expected. BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED requires --premiere-bridge. RUNNER_TIMED_OUT needs a fresh attempt and explicit panel folder selection. CONTRACT_MISMATCH needs matching native sequence structure. No native action is performed to repair the project.

lifecycle.timeout: A shared elapsed deadline bounds human panel selection, observation arrival and final host verification; panel checks expiry before publishing.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared cancellation ends the bounded wait; no native application process is started or killed. Expired jobs cannot publish accepted results.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/plan/request/response/observation, per-attempt nonce and bridge-job path, structured failed result and final verification. No fictitious native process log.
lifecycle.verification: Closed bounded native observation checks exact ticks and source identities against an independent authored plan; request hash/nonce prevent stale attempts. Two complete matching observations, native runtime/project identities and retained byte hashes. Source contents, effects and export are unverified; local wholesale evidence fabrication is outside the trust model.

losses: Absolute paths identify sources; host does not read their bytes.
data.scope: Declared saved project identity, active sequence name/profile and ordered source frame ranges.
